entries.7983c0c1746e665a: Rakuten Group, Inc. describes itself as a global innovation company built on three businesses, Internet Services, FinTech and Mobile, and reports these three as its reportable segments. The nature of these three businesses is not the same. 'Rakuten Ichiba' is a business that operates a marketplace where merchants sell their products rather than the company selling its own inventory, FinTech revenue comes not from merchandise prices but from fee income from cards, banking, securities, insurance and payments, as well as interest and insurance premium income, and Mobile is a business that owns its own communications network. The Rakuten Ecosystem links these three, and the company converts into monetary terms the tendency of 'Rakuten Mobile' MNO contract holders to use the group's various services more than non-contract holders, recording it as 'Mobile Ecosystem Contribution' and reflecting it in segment income or loss. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, ¥14,542 million was transferred from Internet Services and ¥19,480 million from FinTech to Mobile, and ¥34,022 million was added to Mobile.

entries.fc6663c26b94d5ee: The net loss attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥177,886 million, marking a net loss for the fifth consecutive year. Non-GAAP operating income, which the company uses as a management indicator, was ¥106,277 million (¥7,048 million in the previous year), and operating income under IFRS Accounting Standards was ¥14,382 million. Segment profit or loss (after Mobile Ecosystem Contribution) was a profit of ¥199,922 million for FinTech and ¥88,943 million for Internet Services, and a loss of ¥161,841 million for Mobile. The loss in Mobile has narrowed from ¥208,933 million in the previous year.
